FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Visionary Optical Services is a retail optical provider specializing in the sale of high-quality optical frames, lenses, and accessories with an emphasis on customer service and satisfaction. Our operations include a well-maintained storefront equipped to handle customer fittings and consultations. We have a limited in-house laboratory that focuses solely on lens edging, coating, and minor frame repairs, ensuring compliance with industry safety standards to mitigate risks associated with manufacturing. All staff involved in optical fitting and dispensing are licensed and trained, supported by documented quality assurance protocols that minimize operational errors. To enhance customer relations and operational efficiency, we utilize technology for inventory management and customer tracking, fostering a streamlined experience. Our commitment to quality service is evident in our employee training programs that emphasize best practices in optical care and compliance with regulatory requirements. With a strong focus on loss prevention, we maintain a comprehensive security system across our locations to safeguard our inventory and ensure the security of customer transactions.
